HOW TO READ THE TEXTBOOK SCOPE

Required skills.
Clear boundaries.

2026 foundation · 2027 revisions. Find teaching and practice for every detailed syllabus item.

Required
Required syllabus knowledge or skill: use the item-level provision review for the exact source and practice.
Support Booklet
Official support-booklet convention or example. Teach it in its relevant sequence; do not dismiss it as optional enrichment merely because a keyword is not a separate unit bullet.
Implementation
A tool, model or context used to practise required concepts. Its particular software, equipment or syntax is not itself a new syllabus requirement.
Enrichment
Additional content beyond the explicit unit-content list; teach and practise it before including it in a locally issued task.
  • Optional revisit means return after prerequisites; it does not mean that the underlying syllabus skill is optional.
  • School-issued task scope and the official support booklet determine required preparation; this register is editorial guidance, not an assurance that a topic cannot be assessed.
  • Specialist drone, VR and network-pod pathways are companion contexts. The general textbook and ordinary-computer/paper preparation remain available. Actual software/network-tool execution needs an appropriate authorised environment.

HAVING after GROUP BY

support-booklet · HAVING is shown in the official support booklet (printed p22). It filters completed groups; learn it after core GROUP BY and aggregate practice. It is support-booklet SQL, rather than a separately named unit-content bullet or an optional-only topic.

Teaching and practice · Official support reference (online PDF)

LEFT JOIN for unmatched records

enrichment · LEFT JOIN syntax is additional to the explicitly listed INNER JOIN work. It supports this all-session report. Counting real keys and distinguishing NULL from recorded absence remain important reasoning; do not replace required multiple-table INNER JOIN practice with this extension.

Teaching and practice

Composite keys and missing attendance

required · Correct composite references and interpretation of data are required concepts. The LEFT JOIN implementation used here is a supporting extension; both key columns must still match.

Teaching and practice

ACID concepts and explicit SQLite transaction commands

implementation · ACID is required Year 12 knowledge. BEGIN, COMMIT and ROLLBACK illustrate an implementation in the chosen SQLite tool; they are not a separate additional prescribed keyword list. Teach tool behaviour before requiring it locally.

Teaching and practice

Pygame, drone, VR and network-pod contexts

implementation · These are delivery choices for practising required programming, data and networking skills. A graphical user interface and specialist hardware are not general textbook prerequisites. The companion pathway retains local assessment contexts.

Teaching and practice

CPU pipeline and buffer model

implementation · The activity supplies supporting computer-systems context and a constant-rate arithmetic model. It does not add a CPU architecture examination requirement to the mapped unit items.

Teaching and practice

Subnet planning: Year 12 progression

required · The Year 12 address-planning skill is required. Its detailed subnet allocation can be a later bridge for Year 11 learners; a Year 11 extension label must not be read as excluding it from Year 12.

Teaching and practice

Cisco network-diagram conventions

support-booklet · Use the official symbol table (printed p12) when constructing required logical diagrams. Label roles, LAN/WLAN/WAN boundaries, links and the trust perimeter; check symbols against that reference. Generic role boxes alone are not a symbol-convention demonstration.

Teaching and practice · Official support reference (online PDF)

ODBC knowledge versus an installed driver lab

required · The application/driver/data-source/result path is required knowledge. The explanation and independent comparison do not require an installed ODBC driver. A direct sqlite3 example is not described as an ODBC connection.
